image_description: Three Great White Pelicans floating on water. The central pelican is preening with its head tucked into its back feathers, obscuring the bill and pouch. The pelican on the left has its head turned, showing a pinkish bill. The pelican on the right shows a yellow bill. The water has ripples reflecting light.
